summary: Eventa iteration 2 — full stack tested. Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases pass (templates CRUD w/ image_url, event image_url roundtrip, /export/backup shape, /import/backup merge upsert & replace wipe+restore, /export/calendar.ics with valid VCALENDAR/VEVENT). Combined with iteration 1 suite = 23/23 tests pass sequentially. Frontend: logged in as test@eventa.pl, verified Statystyki 'Kalendarz — kopia zapasowa' card with iCal / Eksport JSON / Import JSON buttons (iCal confirmed to hit /api/export/calendar.ics), verified /event/new shows 'Dodaj zdjęcie imprezy' box, 'Zapisz jako szablon' button, and 'Wczytaj z szablonu (1)' opening a modal listing seeded 'Wesele standardowe' template. Iteration-1 flows (login, tab navigation, CSV export) still intact.

minor.issue: DTEND wraparound after 20:00 uses (hour+4)%24 without advancing the DATE — a 22:00 event becomes 02:00 on the SAME day (end < start). Cosmetic — most calendar apps still accept it, but iCal validators may warn.

issues: Pre-existing RN-web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' — cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) In /api/export/calendar.ics, when time+4h wraps past midnight, roll the DTEND date forward by 1 day so end > start.
(Optional / carry-over from iter1) add testID props on FAB, tabs, and form inputs to remove reliance on Polish text selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py backup import correctly strips computed fields (labor_cost, material_cost, total_cost, profit) from events on re-import so they are recomputed by compute_event_summary on read — good.
Backup export strips owner_id and _id from staff/events/templates — good for portability across accounts.
Import 'replace' mode deletes staff/events/templates for the owner only (not global) — correct multi-tenant behaviour.
Templates and events accept image_url as Optional[str] with '' default — base64 data URIs stored inline in Mongo. For very large images this could bloat documents; acceptable for MVP.
iCal endpoint uses PlainTextResponse with CRLF line endings and text/calendar mime type — compliant.
seed_data_creation: test_iteration2.py registers its own itest_<uuid>@eventa.pl user and creates its own staff/events/templates; iteration-1 fixtures still clean up. Existing seeded test@eventa.pl user (with 1 event + 1 template) used for UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Running the full suite with pytest-xdist (default addopts in /app/backend/pytest.ini) can produce 2 flaky failures because TestBackup::test_import_replace_wipes_and_reinserts wipes data mid-run and workers share the same DB. Run with `-o addopts=''` for a stable sequential run, or keep the iter2 file's user isolated (already done via module-scoped fixture). Backend BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All iteration-2 endpoints require Bearer auth.
